meta.name: using-superpowers
meta.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让每轮对话一开始就自动找到并用对合适的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你装了多个技能,却总在开工时想不起来该调用哪一个
copy.tagline_en: Make every conversation start by finding and invoking the right skill
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have many skills installed but forget which one to call when starting work

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在回应任何内容之前(包括反问澄清),都会先查找并调用相关技能,并声明「Using [skill] to [purpose]」再严格照做。若技能带清单,它会为每一项建一条待办。
howto.when: 每次开始对话或任务时触发:只要有 1% 可能相关,就必须先调用技能,再回答或行动。被派去执行特定任务的子代理会忽略此技能。

say.text: 先调用 brainstorming 技能,再帮我规划这个功能
say.note: 会先走头脑风暴流程再进入计划模式

say.text: 开始前先说清你在用哪个技能,并照它的清单来做
say.note: 它会宣布所用技能并逐项建待办

say.text: 修这个 bug 前,先走 systematic-debugging 技能
say.note: 会先系统化调试,再动手改代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude looks for and invokes the relevant skill before any response or action — including clarifying questions. It then announces "Using [skill] to [purpose]", follows the skill exactly, and creates a todo per checklist item.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of any conversation or task: if there is a 1% chance a skill applies, it must be invoked before answering or acting. Subagents dispatched for a specific task ignore this skill.

say_en.text: Invoke the brainstorming skill first, then help me plan this feature
say_en.note: It brainstorms before entering plan mode

say_en.text: State which skill you're using first, and follow its checklist
say_en.note: It announces the skill and creates a todo per item

say_en.text: Before fixing this bug, run the systematic-debugging skill
say_en.note: It debugs systematically before touching code
